payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP: dp[i] = dp[i-1] * C(total_positions, a[i]-1), where total_positions = sum_{j< i} a[j] + a[i] - 1, modulo 1e9+7.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single DP array and heavily relies on combinations to count interleavings, fitting dp_counting_combinatorics perfectly.
